requirements.text: Amounts are integer minor units using each currency's ISO 4217 exponent (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD/BHD 3)
User-entered amounts are parsed strictly without floating point; malformed or over-precise input is rejected
Display is locale-aware: symbol, grouping and decimal separators
Rate and conversion results use an explicit rounding mode such as half-even
Splitting an amount into parts always sums exactly to the total
Combining amounts in different currencies is refused
